svg.title: keenetic-mcp in Claude Code
svg.desc: A Claude Code session with keenetic-mcp. Asked to put the TV and the work laptop on the WireGuard VPN and to give smart home devices their own Wi-Fi that cannot see the home network, Claude reads the policies and devices, assigns both devices to the VPN policy, creates an isolated IoT segment with its own Wi-Fi, reports that every change was read back and that nothing is saved yet, and saves when asked.

text.tspan: , so the TV and the laptop just go on it. For
